conclusions.text: Both exact Atlas subject IDs resolve to the pinned native geoBoundaries features, each uniquely named in its complete country ADM2 roster. The source-record parent and name links remain an authored crosswalk based on the cited existing evidence.

The two complete-footprint discrepancy ratios were independently recomputed from captured source/code bytes and agree with the retained prior ratios. They do not select an authoritative or accurate footprint.

The two specified ways have identical nodes and coordinates in the retained county responses and exact outer membership in the retained county/national relation records. This establishes source-record topology only.
Official/legal/historical boundary identity, an effective date, positional accuracy, physical water, sovereignty, and the PAK underlying Wikipedia work/license remain unresolved.
